title: NZ MBIE Determination 2025/005 (comparative): proposed conversion of Level 5 from office to apartment
jurisdiction: New Zealand (Building Act 2004); Auckland Council; comparative only, not Alberta
code_edition: NZ Building Code (Schedule 1, Building Regulations 1992) as cited; F7/AS1 referenced (edition not stated in extracted text)

facts.text: The owner applied on 10 October 2022 for building consent to convert Level 5 from commercial office space to a single residential apartment.
The building is a 17-level structure with two lower parking levels and a mix of residential and commercial use.
The building has a sprinkler system and supplementary smoke detection in some levels; the proposed Level 5 work adds a Type 5 enhanced smoke detection system.
The owner's fire engineer completed a fire engineering design report for the proposed Level 5 conversion.
Fire and Emergency New Zealand was consulted under section 170(a).
